messages:
alex_k: Quick kickoff — need to lock scope for the 'regional compatibility score' feature for smart routing fallback. Customer asks (EU fintech compliance, APAC low-latency) + limited dev runway. Proposal: MVP = tiered score + deterministic fallthrough; Stretch = probabilistic routing + live model scoring. Which customer asks must land in MVP?
maria_chang: +1. From product: mandate for MVP: (1) EU model pinning for compliance, (2) graceful fallthrough to CPU-hosted quantized variant, (3) observability hooks for scoring reasons. Anything else is stretch.
samir: Implementation note: computing a compatibility score per request adds CPU on the fast path. We should define cost budget per token. If score calc costs >1ms p50, it kills latency SLO. Can we precompute for model variants?
jin_park: We can precompute model->region compatibility heuristics and cache TTL 5m, compute fast path as hash lookups. For edge-case models we fallback to async scoring. Example policy snippet:```yaml
policy_version: 1
scoring:
  mode: cached_lookup
  ttl: 300s
  fallback: async_score
tiers:
  - name: gold
    prefer_local_region: true
    compatible_variants: [fp16, q4_0]
  - name: standard
    prefer_local_region: false
    compatible_variants: [q4_0, q4_1]
```
nina_pm: Acceptance criteria draft for MVP: - deterministic fallback path exercised in 3 synthetic scenarios (region down, model OOM, capacity exhausted). - 99th percentile latency degradation <= 20% vs baseline for 95% of routes. - Audit log includes score + reason for every fallback.
alex_k: Good list. Adding release gates: must pass chaos test (regional partitioning) and customer pilot with two accounts (one EU regulated, one APAC low-latency) before GA.
maria_chang: Edge cases to call out in PRD: - model variant incompatible due to tokenizer mismatch - variant returns different structured output (function-calling mismatch) - pinned model has expired certs (private deployment). Proposed handling: if structural incompat, block auto-fallback and surface error to app with clearly documented error code.
samir: For tokenization mismatch we should attempt a transform shim only for text generation (not for embeddings). Risky but reduces customer disruptions. Add to stretch with feature flag.
jin_park: Questions about rollout: do we enable scoring by default for hosted customers? I'd prefer opt-in for first month and enabled for all Dedicated after next release.
alex_k: Agree opt-in for hosted. Need a migration plan and communication. Nina, can you draft release note + pilot invite copy?
routing-bot: Simulation job #3821 finished: regional-compat run across 50k requests => pass rate 98.1% for deterministic fallback, median added latency 0.8ms. Full logs: https://ci.internal/sim/3821 :thumbsup:
maria_chang: Nice. Next steps: PRD with scope table (MVP vs Stretch), acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and a small RFC for the scoring TTL + cache invalidation semantics. I'll create a PR with the outline later today. :eyes:
